extracted.intended_audience: fans, editors, and researchers of the Comedy Bang! Bang! podcast episode history
extracted.subtask_description: A structured, chronological episode list for a comedy podcast that records key metadata (number, date, guests), short synopses/segments (including recurring games), and featured songs; used as a reference or episode guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Episode number
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as the identifying index for each entry (e.g., 'Episode 270:'). Use sequential numbering to locate episodes within the series.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The original release/air date for the episode (e.g., '2/10/14'). Include month/day/year to situate episodes in chronology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guests
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List of guest performers on the episode. May include actor/comedian names and parenthetical or inline notes of roles they play (e.g., 'James Adomian as Jesse Ventura', 'Jon Daly as himself and Sappity Tappity'). Include multiple guests separated by commas or line breaks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Synopsis and segments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short episode synopsis and the segments contained in the episode. Often lists recurring segments and sketches (for example: 'Games: Would You Rather?'; character sketch names). This field aggregates the episode's notable bits and structural segments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Featured songs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Songs played or featured during the episode, often listed with song title and artist (e.g., '"Longer Than You've Been Alive" by Old 97's'). Can include multiple tracks; useful for music references and credits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Games (recurring segment labels)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many entries annotate a recurring 'Games:' line naming the mini-game(s) played (examples from the page: 'Games: Would You Rather?', 'Games: Riddle Me This', 'Games: Solo Bolo Olympic Song Challenge'). Record the game names verbatim to indicate recurring formats within episodes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best of (yearly) compilations / rankings
rubrics_metrics.description: Best of [year] Pt. X / ranked highlights
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Periodic 'Best of' lists that rank memorable bits/characters from the year (e.g., 'Best of 2014 Pt. 1' with numbered entries). Include the year and ranking entries; these act as curated highlights rather than standard episode metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: NOTE / 'also featuring' lines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Occasional annotation lines that call out additional appearances or special mentions (e.g., 'NOTE: also featuring Scott Aukerman as Dabney and Andy Daly's daughter as Birthday Girl'). Preserve these notes to capture non-standard credits or cameo details.
